changes: Added a place for guardians and other people who don't live with the family but should be on file — name, relationship, phone, email, address, and any documents they should have. Find it as its own tab on a family member's profile.

Added Anniversaries & special days — record wedding anniversaries, engagements, and other dates worth remembering, with one-click shortcuts to add Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, or New Year's Eve.
Added a School dates panel to the Family Calendar, so upcoming school events show up at a glance instead of needing a search through the calendar.

The Family Calendar's at-a-glance panels — Travel documents, Birthdays, Name days & celebrations, Medical checks, Anniversaries, and School dates — can each be turned on or off from Settings > Calendar panels.
